_about: Which of the church's four goals (who-we-are.txt, Our Goals) each ministry serves. Set ONLY where the church's own words say so; every answer quotes the capture line that says it. The two left null are questions for the church, not gaps to fill: their own pages point at more than one goal. Read by scripts/set-ministry-goals.mjs (dry by default) and by /styleguide/ministries, so the fixture shows the page as it will be once the answers are written. Values are the goal ids on /who-we-are: worship, the-way, witness, work.
